title: Register stores a bcrypt hash and opens a session
steps: POST /api/auth/register {name,email,password}; read users + sessions in DB
expected: 201 {accessToken,user}; Set-Cookie rt HttpOnly SameSite=Strict; users.passwordHash starts with $2 and is not the plain password; one session row with tokenHash
proves: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and logins are tracked server-side (advanced requirement: bcrypt)

title: Duplicate email is rejected
steps: Register the same email twice (different case)
expected: Second call 409 EMAIL_TAKEN
proves: Unique index + lower-casing + E11000 → 409 mapping in the error middleware

title: Wrong password and unknown email look the same
steps: Login with wrong password; login with unknown email
expected: Both 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS with identical message
proves: No user enumeration through the login form

title: Protected routes need a valid JWT
steps: GET /api/wallets with no token, a tampered token, an expired token
expected: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED

title: Refresh rotates the token and detects reuse
steps: Refresh A → B; use B → C; present A again. Also: A → B, then present A after 31 s with B unused
expected: Each refresh gives a new token and revokes the old row (replacedBy); reuse of A after its replacement was used, or after the 30 s grace window, → 401 and every session of the user revoked
proves: Refresh-token rotation and stolen-token reuse detection work

title: Logout revokes the session
steps: Login; POST /auth/logout; POST /auth/refresh with the same cookie
expected: Logout 204, cookie cleared; refresh 401 INVALID_REFRESH
proves: Logout is real (server-side), not just deleting a token in the browser

title: Login is rate-limited
steps: 11 failed logins from one IP within 15 min
expected: 11th call 429
proves: Basic brute-force protection is active

title: Register, reload, logout in a real browser
steps: Register via UI → dashboard; reload page; click Logout; open /transactions
expected: Still logged in after reload; after logout redirected to /login
proves: AuthContext + silent refresh + ProtectedRoute work together (state requirement: Context for login)

title: Locked user cannot log in
steps: Admin sets userB status=locked; userB logs in
expected: 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED
proves: Account status is enforced at login

title: Log out other devices

expected: 204; device 2 refresh 401; device 1 still works
proves: Session list and selective revocation work

title: Wallet CRUD uses correct methods and codes
steps: POST, GET list, GET one, PATCH, DELETE /api/wallets
expected: 201, 200, 200, 200, 204; list no longer shows the deleted wallet
proves: REST design: right HTTP method and status code for each action

title: User B cannot touch user A's wallet
steps: As userB: GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/wallets/<userA wallet id>
expected: 404 for all three; userA's wallet unchanged in DB
proves: Every query is scoped by userId (no data leaks by guessing IDs)

title: Wallet in use cannot be deleted
steps: Create confirmed transaction on wallet; DELETE wallet
expected: 409 WALLET_IN_USE
proves: Relations between collections are protected in the app layer

title: Balance counts only confirmed, non-deleted transactions
steps: initial 100k; +income 50k; expense 30k; draft expense 20k; deleted expense 10k; GET /api/wallets
expected: balance = 120000
proves: Balance aggregation is correct

title: Wallet card updates after adding a transaction

expected: Balance drops by 30,000 without manual refresh

expected: All template categories present with vi/en names and keywords; 'Tiền mặt' default wallet

title: Category CRUD + validation

title: Keyword input strips diacritics

title: Only positive integer VND amounts

title: Cannot use someone else's wallet or category

proves: Soft delete keeps data recoverable and stats consistent

proves: Full CRUD works for a customer in the browser

title: Month boundaries use Vietnam time

proves: Server running in UTC still groups by Vietnamese calendar

proves: Unique compound index and CRUD (topic requirement: monthly budget)

title: Dashboard charts and month switch

title: Parser rule table

proves: Basic accessibility and contrast in dark mode

proves: Zalo flow without buttons on the deployed system

proves: KIE integration and graceful failure

expected: < 10 min; zero errors in logs

title: Config validation fails fast
steps: parseEnv() in production mode with MONGODB_URI missing, a short JWT_ACCESS_SECRET and an invalid optional TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET; parseEnv() in production mode with only MONGODB_URI and JWT_ACCESS_SECRET; parseEnv() in test mode
expected: Startup error names every missing or invalid variable and never prints a value; bot, KIE, APP_URL and seed variables are optional (empty counts as unset) and checked only when set; test mode fills safe defaults
proves: The API refuses to start without what it truly needs, never leaks secrets into logs, and does not depend on optional integrations

title: Degraded boot
steps: Start server/src/local.js with NODE_ENV=production, only MONGODB_URI (unreachable) and JWT_ACCESS_SECRET; GET /api/health
expected: The API starts listening; health answers 503 {status:'error', db:'down'}; the process keeps running
proves: Missing integration secrets or a down database never stop the API from booting or crash it

title: Update profile and preferences
steps: PATCH /api/users/me {name, language, theme, role, email}; invalid values; defaultWalletId of own, another user's and a deleted wallet; null
expected: 200 with name/language/theme changed and role/email unchanged; invalid values 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; own wallet 200, other user's or deleted wallet 404 NOT_FOUND; null clears it
proves: Users can edit only their own profile fields, and the default wallet must belong to them

title: Change password
steps: Login on laptop and phone; laptop PATCH /api/users/me/password with a wrong, then a too short, then a valid new password; both devices refresh; login with old and new password
expected: Wrong current 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; short 400; valid 204; phone refresh 401, laptop refresh 200; old password 401, new password 200
proves: A password change needs the current password, is stored as a new bcrypt hash and logs out every other device

title: requireRole('admin') guard
steps: GET a route behind requireAuth + requireRole('admin') as a user, as an admin (fresh token after the role change) and without a token
expected: user 403 FORBIDDEN; admin 200; no token 401
proves: The role claim in the JWT gates admin-only routes

title: Seeding users is idempotent
steps: seedUsers(env) then seedUsers(env, {test:true}) twice; seedUsers({}) with nothing configured; login as the seeded admin
expected: `seed` creates only the admin; `seed:test` adds userA and userB; no duplicates on a second run; missing variables are skipped with a message; the admin logs in with role admin
proves: npm run seed / seed:test can be run on any environment repeatedly without breaking data

title: One shared refresh for parallel expired requests
steps: Three API calls at once answer 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED; refresh succeeds. Then: refresh fails. Then: a 403 that is not TOKEN_EXPIRED
expected: Exactly one POST /api/auth/refresh, all three calls retried with the new token; a failed refresh clears the session; other errors are returned without a refresh
proves: baseQueryWithRefresh never sends two refreshes at once (which the server's rotation would treat as token theft) and logs the user out cleanly when the refresh cookie is no longer valid

title: Login and register forms validate and translate errors

proves: Forms give accessible, bilingual feedback and only send valid input to the API

title: Route guards

expected: Visitor goes to /login and back to the page they asked for; logged-in user is sent to /; non-admin sees 403, admin sees the page; admin links only in an admin's navigation
proves: ProtectedRoute and AdminRoute enforce login and role in the UI (the API enforces them too)

title: Template seeding and default data are idempotent

title: Confirm a draft

expected: First 200 {transaction} with status confirmed and the wallet balance now counts it; second 409 ALREADY_CONFIRMED; deleted 404; draft in a deleted wallet 404 details walletId not_found and stays a draft
proves: Drafts become real money only once, through the same confirm step the bots use

title: chatRef unique partial index
steps: Create drafts with chatRef telegram/111/7 twice, telegram/222/7, zalo/111/7, and two without chatRef
expected: Second telegram/111/7 fails with E11000; the other five are stored

title: budgetWarning thresholds
steps: Budget Ăn uống 1,000,000 for 2026-11; confirmed expenses 799,999, then +1, then +250,000; then an overall budget 1,400,000 and a 100,000 Đi lại expense; call budgetWarning(user, category, month) after each step

proves: The service the bots (T11) and /confirm use warns exactly at 80 % and 100 % of the category or overall budget

title: setWebhooks registers both bots

title: Locked account and the bot

proves: Admin edits never break the default set or the 'Other' fallback every new user needs, and cannot reach users' own categories

title: Admin screens
steps: Admin opens /admin/users: search + status filter, lock Minh via the confirm dialog, try to remove the last admin; lock the only user on page 2 of the active list; opens /admin/categories: add (first with a 41-character keyword), edit, delete a template, switch to the income tab
expected: Stats shown; filters sent on submit only; PATCH {status:'locked'} only after confirming; LAST_ADMIN shown translated; the emptied page 2 goes back to page 1; the long keyword is blocked in the browser with a translated message and nothing is sent; POST/PATCH/DELETE bodies correct; no delete button on the fallback
proves: The admin UI drives the admin API correctly and asks before destructive actions

title: Transactions screen: list, URL-synced filters, add/edit dialog, delete with Undo
steps: Open /transactions and /transactions?type=income; change wallet and search filters; clear them; add with amount '45k' and a chosen date-time; edit the amount to '50k'; delete a row and press Undo with the keyboard; open ?page=2 when the server says total 3
expected: Rows show category, wallet and a signed amount (−/+), drafts marked 'Nháp'; filters are read from and written to the query string, search waits for a typing pause; the dialog validates and focuses the first wrong field, sends amount 45000 and occurredAt with +07:00; PATCH amount 50000; DELETE then POST /restore brings the row back, focus moves to Undo when it appears and to the page heading after it; a page past the last one is replaced by the last page (?page=1)
proves: Customers can browse, filter and correct their history on the web, and a delete can be undone

title: Amount field shortcuts and Vietnam time in the form
steps: parseAmount on '45k', '1,5tr', '1tr5', '150.000', '0', '-5', '12.5', 'abc', a 19-digit number; datetime-local conversion of 2026-11-30T17:10Z
expected: 45000, 1500000, 1500000, 150000, then null for each invalid one; the form shows 2026-12-01T00:10 and sends 2026-12-01T00:10:00+07:00
proves: The web form accepts the same k/tr shortcuts as the bot and never shifts dates by the browser's time zone

title: Quick add: debounced preview, Enter, errors, several lines, chip edit, Shift+Enter
steps: Type 'phở 45k' and wait; press Enter; type 'abc' + Enter; paste 3 lines + Enter; change a preview chip's wallet then Enter; type 'cafe 30k' + Shift+Enter and save the form; with a slow parse, type 'phở 45k' then Enter, Enter and click Lưu; preview 'cafe 30k mm' then invalidate wallets
expected: One parse call after the pause (none per key) and preview chips (amount, category, wallet, date); Enter POSTs the draft and clears the box; 'abc' shows NO_AMOUNT_FOUND inline in Vietnamese with aria-invalid and saves nothing; 3 lines → 3 POSTs in order; the chip edit changes the saved walletId; Shift+Enter opens the full form pre-filled with the parsed draft; presses during a running parse are ignored, so exactly 1 POST; a wallet/category change re-parses the same text so no stale ids are saved
proves: The quick-add box behaves as docs/05 §5.7 describes, with nothing saved by the preview

title: Link card: code, countdown, Telegram link + QR, Zalo command, expiry, unlink
steps: Open /bot with one linked Telegram account; Generate code; unlink the account; open /bot with GET /chat-links failing once, press Retry; with a code that expires in 1 s and no bot username, Generate, wait, then Create a new code against a 429
expected: The code, 'Hết hạn sau 10:00', 'Mở Telegram' → the deep link, a QR image and '/link CODE'; focus moves to the code; unlink asks first, sends DELETE /chat-links/:id, the list shows 'none linked' and focus is on its heading; a failed list load shows a translated error with Retry; no Telegram link or QR when telegramDeepLink is null; the expired code is replaced by 'expired' + a new-code button; 429 shows RATE_LIMITED in Vietnamese
proves: Linking from the web works as docs/05 §5.7 describes, including the expiry and the rate limit

title: QR encoder output
steps: qrMatrix('HELLO'); reedSolomon on the ISO 18004 example; qrMatrix of a deep link, a 32-character bot name link, and 107 characters
expected: The exact 21×21 symbol of the reference qrcode package (byte mode, level L, mask 0); EC codewords 165 36 212 193 237 54 199 135 44 85; a 29×29 symbol; at most 37×37; an error
proves: The QR code on the Bot inbox is a valid, scannable symbol without a QR library

title: Link the real Telegram and Zalo chats
steps: bot-e2e TG-01, TG-09, ZL-01 (docs/testing/bot-e2e.md): /start CODE in Telegram Web, /link CODE in Zalo Web, then a second code
expected: 'Đã liên kết với tài khoản …' in both chats; GET /chat-links lists telegram and zalo; a linked chat refuses a second code
proves: Linking works through the real chat apps, not only with recorded payloads

title: Drafts list: sources, inline edit, receipt items, confirm, discard
steps: Open /bot with a Telegram, a Zalo and a receipt draft; clear the amount of 'phở' and Confirm; type 50k and Confirm; expand the receipt items; Confirm the unchanged Zalo draft (budget at 85 %); Discard the receipt draft
expected: Each card shows its source; an empty amount is marked aria-invalid, focused, and nothing is sent; then PATCH {amount: 50000} before POST /confirm and the card leaves the list; the receipt shows '2 dòng hàng · khớp tổng tiền' and its lines; the unchanged draft sends only POST /confirm and the budget warning shows; Discard asks first, then DELETE; after each Confirm or Discard focus is on the drafts heading, not <body>
proves: Drafts from chat can be corrected inline and only the needed requests are sent

title: Opening the inbox again refetches drafts
steps: Open /bot (3 drafts); leave; the server confirms one (as 'ok' in a chat does); open /bot again in the app
expected: Bản nháp chờ duyệt (2); the confirmed draft is gone without a reload
proves: Drafts changed in the chats never linger in the web inbox (regression test for BUG-004)

title: Upload: resized image sent as field 'image', status while reading, errors translated
steps: Choose a photo (resize mocked) with a slow /api/receipts; let it answer 201; upload again against 422 RECEIPT_UNREADABLE; choose a PDF that cannot be opened as an image
expected: The resized JPEG (not the original) is POSTed as multipart field 'image'; a polite status 'Đang đọc hoá đơn…' and a disabled button while waiting; then 'Đã tạo bản nháp…' and the new draft in the list; RECEIPT_UNREADABLE and UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE in Vietnamese; the PDF is never sent
proves: The web upload shows progress for the 20–40 s KIE read and explains every failure

title: Budgets screen: bars with text labels, add/edit/delete, copy from last month
steps: Open /budgets with budgets at 50 %, 80 %, 90 % and 120 % (overall); add with an empty limit, then '300k' for the only free category; edit a limit to '1tr5'; delete a budget; go to the next (empty) month, add an overall budget '2tr' and click Copy from last month
expected: Overall budget first; each card has a native progress bar named by its category (value capped at the limit), 'Đã chi … / … (n%)' and a level word: 'Trong hạn mức' below 80 %, 'Sắp hết' from 80 % to 100 %, 'Vượt ngân sách' above, plus 'Còn …' or 'Vượt …'; the add dialog offers only categories without a budget, an empty limit shows a translated error on the focused field and sends nothing; POST {month, categoryId, limit:300000}; edit hides the category and sends PATCH {limit:1500000}; DELETE only after the confirm dialog; the empty month shows its empty state, POST {categoryId:null, limit:2000000}, then POST /budgets/copy {from: this month, to: next month} and 'Đã chép ngân sách: 3'
proves: The budgets screen drives the docs/04 budgets API and shows usage with colour and text, never colour alone

title: Dashboard: month cards, chart summaries, drafts banner, latest 5, month switch, error
steps: Open / with stats for this month, 2 drafts and 7 confirmed transactions; click Previous month (no data, no overall budget); make /stats/summary fail, then click Retry
expected: h1 greets the user; cards show income, expense, net and budget left with 'Hạn mức …'; the pie figure lists 'Category: amount (n%)' for each slice and the daily figure says the totals and the biggest spending day; 'Có 2 giao dịch nháp…' links to /bot; 5 latest transactions with signed amounts and a link to /transactions; after the month switch the cards show 0 ₫, 'Chưa đặt ngân sách tổng' links to /budgets and both figures say the month is empty; a failed request shows the translated error and Retry loads the cards
proves: The dashboard reads the docs/04 stats API for the month in the shared MonthPicker and gives every chart a text alternative

title: Settings screen: profile, password form, device names
steps: Open /settings as Lan (default wallet Tiền mặt); clear the name and Save; type '  Lan Anh ', pick Momo and Save; open the account menu. In Đổi mật khẩu submit empty, then a wrong current password with mismatched new ones, then matching ones, then the right current password. Name devices from Chrome/Windows, Safari/iPhone, Chrome/Android, Edge/macOS, Firefox/Linux and curl user agents
expected: Empty name keeps focus with 'Họ tên từ 1 đến 60 ký tự' and sends nothing; then PATCH /users/me {name:'Lan Anh', defaultWalletId:'w2'}, 'Đã lưu hồ sơ' and the account menu shows Lan Anh without a new login. Password: field errors with focus on the first wrong field, nothing sent until valid; 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS shows 'Mật khẩu hiện tại không đúng' on that field; success clears the form, says other devices were logged out and the device list refetches; inputs use autocomplete current-password / new-password. Devices: 'Chrome · Windows', 'Safari · iOS', 'Chrome · Android', 'Edge · macOS', 'Firefox · Linux', unknown → 'Thiết bị không rõ'
proves: The Settings page drives PATCH /users/me and /users/me/password with the API's rules, translated errors and accessible focus handling, and AuthContext shows the saved profile at once

title: A refresh whose answer was lost does not log out every device
steps: Second device logged in; refresh A → B (answer lost); refresh A again within 30 s; use the new token C; refresh on the second device; present A a third time
expected: 200 with a new token C; unused B revoked; C and the second device keep working; the third A (its replacement C was used) → 401 and every session revoked
proves: Lost refresh answers are forgiven once, real reuse is still caught (regression test for BUG-003)

title: Hermetic E2E server: bot calls stubbed, other external hosts blocked
steps: With server/test/helpers/bot-api-stub.js active, send a message through the production Telegram and Zalo adapters, fetch https://example.com and a Zalo photo URL, fetch 127.0.0.1 and localhost; start test/helpers/e2e-server.js with real-looking bot tokens and POST an unlinked Telegram update and Zalo event to the webhooks
expected: Bot API calls answer {ok:true, result:{message_id, chat, …}} and are recorded as {platform, method, chatId} without the token; other hosts fail with a network error and a '[bot-api-stub] blocked outbound request to <host>' log line; local hosts pass through; the E2E server logs '[bot-api-stub] telegram|zalo sendMessage chat=<id>' for both replies, no 'webhook update failed' and never a token
proves: BUG-002 is fixed: the Playwright suite can never message a real Telegram or Zalo chat, and a new outbound call cannot slip in unnoticed

title: Category breakdown: each row keeps its category colour, no two rows share one
steps: sliceColors() for 9 rows: two categories with their own colours, a third repeating one of them, six with none; and a category whose colour equals the first fallback
expected: Own colours kept (lower-cased); the repeated colour and the colourless rows get fallback colours; all 9 colours distinct; a fallback already taken by a category is skipped
proves: The dashboard's category breakdown never marks two categories with the same colour (bug seen in the 2026-11-20 captures: 6 rank colours for 8 categories), and a row matches its category colour elsewhere in the app

title: UI fonts are self-hosted and draw Vietnamese text
steps: Open /login in vi; read the h1's computed font-family; document.fonts.load('300 32px "Be Vietnam Pro"', 'Sổ chi tiêu ữ'); record every request to another host
expected: h1 font-family starts with "Be Vietnam Pro"; the loaded faces are all 'loaded' and include the Vietnamese subset (U+1EA0-1EF9); no request leaves the app's host
proves: Vietnamese headings render in the design font (no mixed fallback glyphs) and the redesign added no third-party font CDN

title: Weekly comparison: days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–end, against the previous month
steps: weekTotals() over days 1,7,8,14,15,21,22,30,31 for expense and income; previousMonth('2026-11'), previousMonth('2026-01'); dashboard unit test switches the chart to Thu nhập
expected: [150,15,8,12] and [0,3,0,9]; day 31 in week 4; '2026-10' and '2025-12'; the figure's sentence names this month's total, the difference and the highest week
proves: The dashboard's weekly column chart (draft 3, T18) buckets every day of any month into the right week and compares it with the correct calendar month, also across a year boundary

title: bot-e2e.mjs: --help prints the usage; a bad option is one line, not a stack trace
steps: node --test tools/bot-e2e/bot-e2e.test.mjs: run the CLI with --help, with -h, with `list --targt staging` (unknown option) and with `state --target` (option without its value)
expected: --help and -h exit 0 with the usage on stdout and nothing on stderr; both bad options exit 1 with exactly one line on stderr naming the problem, no stack trace and no ERR_PARSE_ARGS code; the unknown option also prints the usage
proves: The real-chat checker's own command line fails like a tool, not like a crash: a typo in an option tells the operator what is wrong and how to call it, and nothing reaches the network (regression test for BUG-007)

title: Revoke-all wins against a rotation running at the same moment
steps: Second device logged in; refresh A → B; pause Session.create inside a parallel rotation (a second grace retry of A, or a refresh of B) right after it claimed its old session; while paused, present A again (theft: revoke all); let the rotation finish. Also: A → B → C, stamp sessionsRevokedAt between A's login and C's creation, refresh C. Also: an admin lock + revoke-all while a refresh is paused the same way
expected: The theft answers 401; the paused rotation answers 401 INVALID_REFRESH; refreshing C answers 401; the locked case answers 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED; in every case no session of the user stays active
proves: "Every session revoked" really leaves none: a refresh between its claim and its new session, or a session created while the revoke-all was being written, cannot keep a chain that began before the revoke-all alive (regression test for BUG-006)

title: Passwords longer than 72 bytes are refused
steps: POST /auth/register with 'ư'×36 + 'a1b2c3d4e5f6' (48 characters, 84 bytes); register with 'ư'×36 (exactly 72 bytes); PATCH /users/me/password with the 84-byte password as newPassword. In Settings → Đổi mật khẩu, enter the 84-byte password as the new one
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details [{path:'password'}] and no user stored; 201 for 72 bytes; 400 with details [{path:'newPassword'}]; the form marks Mật khẩu mới 'Mật khẩu quá dài…', focuses it and sends nothing
proves: bcrypt never silently drops the tail of a password: a different password sharing the first 72 bytes can no longer log in or change the password (regression test for BUG-009)

title: Logging out one or the other devices wins against a refresh on that device
steps: Devices A and B logged in; pause Session.create inside B's refresh right after it claimed its old session; while paused, A sends DELETE /sessions?others=true, or PATCH /users/me/password, or DELETE /sessions/<B's id>, or B sends POST /auth/logout; let the rotation finish; refresh A. Also: B rotates after A loaded the list, A deletes B's old id, then deletes it again
expected: The revoke answers 204; B's rotation answers 401 INVALID_REFRESH; only A's session stays active and A still refreshes; the out-of-date id still logs B out (204, B's new token 401), and a second delete is 404
proves: Every revoke that keeps this device or ends one device (log out others, password change, Settings logout, logout) leaves the revoked device logged out even when its refresh runs at the same moment (regression test for BUG-010)

title: Refresh after an admin lock answers 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED and the login page says so
steps: Devices A (rotated A → B) and a second device; lock the user and revoke all sessions as PATCH /admin/users/:id does; refresh with A, B and the second device's token, then with an unknown token. In the browser: the refresh answers 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED while the app starts at /
expected: 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED for all three tokens (no theft handling), 401 INVALID_REFRESH for the unknown one; the app shows the login page with 'Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khoá…'
proves: docs/04 §4.3 'Login and refresh return 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED' holds after a real admin lock, and a locked user learns why they were logged out (regression test for BUG-011)

title: Register form rejects what the API rejects, on the right field
steps: Open /register; submit with each e-mail nguyễn-1@example.com, a@b.c, a..b@example.com, a@example.com., user@exämple.com, x@example.co1; then a valid e-mail with a 73-character password and with a 48-character Vietnamese one; then let the API answer 400 VALIDATION_ERROR details [{path:'email'}] to a valid form
expected: The password hint states the 72 limit; each e-mail is marked 'Email không hợp lệ'; both passwords are marked 'Mật khẩu quá dài…' and nothing is sent; the API answer shows the alert and also marks the Email field (aria-invalid, its message, focus)
proves: The register page's checks match the server's zod rules and a server-side field error is shown on its field (regression test for BUG-012)

title: Confirm with edits applies them to a draft only
steps: Insert a Telegram draft (40.000); POST /api/transactions/:id/confirm with {amount:12.5}, then {type:'income'}, then {amount:45000, note}. Insert another draft, confirm it without a body (as ✅ in the chat does), then confirm it again with {amount:99000, type:'income', categoryId: Lương}
expected: 400, 400, then 200 with status confirmed, amount 45000 and the trimmed note; the late confirm answers 409 ALREADY_CONFIRMED and the saved transaction keeps amount 40000, type expense; the wallet balance counts 45000 + 40000
proves: The inbox's edits and the confirm are one write guarded by status draft, so a 409 changes nothing (regression test for BUG-008)

title: A stale inbox card cannot rewrite a transaction confirmed in the chat
steps: Open /bot; the server confirms draft 'phở' (45.000) as ✅ in the chat does; on the still-open card change the amount to 99k and press Xác nhận
expected: Exactly one request, POST /transactions/d1/confirm carrying the edits (no PATCH); 'Giao dịch này đã được xác nhận.' is shown, the card leaves the list, and the transaction keeps amount 45000
proves: The web sends edits only through the draft-only confirm, so a refusal never leaves a silent edit behind (regression test for BUG-008)

title: Archiving the default wallet clears the default
steps: Register (default 'Tiền mặt'); add 'MoMo'; PATCH /api/wallets/<default> {archived:true}; GET /api/auth/me; POST /api/transactions/parse 'phở 45k'. Then set users.defaultWalletId back to the archived wallet in the database and parse again
expected: /auth/me defaultWalletId null; both parses return walletId = MoMo (the archived default is ignored even when still stored)
proves: An archived wallet is never chosen for new money by quick add or the bots, and Settings agrees with the server (regression test for BUG-016)

title: Archiving the default wallet updates the signed-in user
steps: Log in as a user whose default wallet is 'Tiền mặt'; open /wallets and archive 'Tiền mặt'
expected: The session's user now has defaultWalletId null, without a reload
proves: The Add form and Settings stop preselecting an archived wallet in the same session (regression test for BUG-016)

title: Parse names the lines it cannot save
steps:
POST /api/transactions/parse 'phở 45k

cafe không tiền
grab 30k'; then 11 lines with amounts
expected: 200 with 2 drafts, noAmountLines [3] (line numbers as typed), truncated false; 11 lines → 10 drafts, noAmountLines [], truncated true
proves: The caller learns about every line that will not become a transaction (regression test for BUG-017)

title: Quick add refuses to drop lines
steps: Paste 'phở 45k / cafe không tiền / grab 30k' and wait; press Enter. Clear, paste 11 lines with amounts and wait; press Enter
expected: The hint says 'Dòng 2 không có số tiền…'; Enter marks the box invalid, saves nothing and keeps the text. With 11 lines the hint says 'Mỗi lần chỉ lưu được 10 dòng…' and Enter saves nothing
proves: Nothing the user typed is thrown away silently; the box is only cleared after every line was saved (regression test for BUG-017)

title: One money value is at most 10^13 ₫
steps: POST/PATCH a transaction amount, POST a budget limit and a wallet initialBalance of 10^13 + 1 and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (±10^13 + 1 for the balance); then exactly 10^13 (−10^13 for a credit wallet); create a Transaction model with 10^13 + 1 directly
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for every value above the ceiling; 201 at the ceiling; the model rejects amount 10^13 + 1
proves: Wallet balances and month totals, summed as doubles, stay exact safe integers (regression test for BUG-018)

title: Every line is saved even when the bot's reply fails
steps: Zalo sendMessage answers ok:false; send 'cafe 21k\nbánh mì 22k\ntaxi 23k'
expected: 3 drafts (21.000, 22.000, 23.000); pendingTransactionId is the last one; the failure is logged once
proves: A failed reply (quota, 429, timeout) never loses the lines after it, since the platform never resends (regression test for BUG-026)

title: Zalo amount-only reply corrects the pending draft
steps: Zalo 'grab 32k' → '55k' → 'ok'; then '40k' with nothing pending
expected: One draft, now 55.000 with note 'grab' and its category, re-sent with the hint and still pending; 'ok' confirms it; '40k' alone later is a new draft
proves: docs/02 §2.4 'Reply with a corrected line (e.g. 55k)' edits the draft instead of making a second one (regression test for BUG-027)

title: Zalo ok/huy reach every draft of a multi-line message
steps: Zalo 'an sang 30k\ntra sua 40k' → 'ok' → 'huy' → 'ok'
expected: 'ok' saves 40.000 and names the 30.000 draft as next; 'huy' discards 30.000; only then 'nothing pending'
proves: No draft the bot asked to confirm is left unreachable from Zalo (regression test for BUG-028)

title: /month shows category budget usage
steps: Food budget 150.000 with 135.000 spent, Transport 320.000 with 64.000, no overall budget; send /month
expected: Lines 'Ngân sách "Ăn uống": 90% (135.000 ₫ / 150.000 ₫)' then Transport 20%, fullest first; no overall line; GET /stats/summary budget stays null
proves: /month gives 'month total and budget usage' (docs/02) for category budgets too, without changing the summary API (regression test for BUG-029)

title: After a logout the next user starts at /
steps: Lan opens /transactions?walletId=w1 → account menu → Đăng xuất; Minh logs in on the same browser
expected: URL is / with no query; Dashboard says 'Xin chào, Minh'
proves: An explicit logout does not save the previous user's page and filters as the next login's destination; only a deep link opened while logged out is restored (regression test for BUG-013)

title: Failed preference save says the choice lasts only until a reload
steps: PATCH /users/me fails; click the dark-theme toggle; re-mount the app (reload)
expected: Warning 'Không lưu được lựa chọn vào tài khoản. Lựa chọn chỉ có hiệu lực đến khi tải lại trang – vui lòng thử lại.'; dark applies now; after the reload the profile theme is back
proves: The warning matches docs/05 §5.6 (profile wins at start-up) instead of promising the choice stays on the device (regression test for BUG-014)

title: App bar and drawer avatars show the same initials
steps: Render UserMenu and NavDrawer for the user 'Nguyễn Văn An'
expected: Both avatars show 'VA'
proves: One shared initials helper: one user, one avatar on the same screen (regression test for BUG-025)

title: Admin users list recovers from a failed load
steps: First GET /admin/users answers 500 → press Thử lại; later one more 500 after Tìm with the same search → press Tìm again
expected: Error alert with a Retry button and no 'Đang tải…' or stale rows; Retry and a repeated Tìm both send the request and show the list
proves: A failed admin list can be loaded again without reloading the page (regression test for BUG-015)

title: Long linked-chat name with no spaces wraps inside the card
steps: GET /chat-links returns a Telegram link whose displayName is 64 characters with no spaces; open /bot
expected: The name element has overflow-wrap: anywhere
proves: A long chat name breaks inside the Linked accounts card instead of making /bot scroll sideways (TC-NF-02) (regression test for BUG-030)

title: Receipt status and error follow a language switch
steps: Upload succeeds, then POST /receipts answers 502 KIE_UNAVAILABLE; press EN; upload again; press VI
expected: The alert becomes 'The receipt reader is unavailable…'; the done line switches EN ↔ VI with the page
proves: Upload status and errors are kept as keys/codes and translated when shown (docs/02 §2.7) (regression test for BUG-031)
